examples.arabic: قال لازم تمشي دغري عشر دقايق وبعدين تلف يمين
examples.english: He said you must walk straight for ten minutes and then turn right.
examples.transliteration: qal lazem temshi deghri aasher daqayeq wbaadayn tlef yamin

examples.english: He said go straight then right

examples.arabic: الشايب صاحب محل الفلافل، اللي قادة كتير متل حكيم، ابتسم وقال: "شوفي يا بنتي، إمشي دغري وبعدين لفّي يمين عند كشك الجرائد الملونة."
examples.english: The elderly owner of the falafel shop, who has guided many like a wise person, smiled and said: "Look, my daughter, walk straight and then turn right at the colorful newspaper stand."
examples.transliteration: El shayeb sahib mahal el falafel, illi qadah kteer metl hakeem, ibtasam w 'al: "Shufi ya binti, imshi doghri w ba'deen laffi yameen 'ind koshk el jara'ed el mulawwana."
examples.storyTitle: Layla in Hamra: The Donation Journey

examples.arabic: وفجأة طلع شب عم يضحك وقلي تفضلي من هاد الشارع بعدين يمين
examples.english: Suddenly, a young man appeared laughing and told me, 'Go straight down this street, then turn right.'
examples.transliteration: W faj'a ṭala' shab 'am yiḍḥak w qali tafaḍḍali min hād ash-shāre' ba'dēn yamīn.

examples.arabic: هو قال لي روح دغري وبعدين لف يمين
examples.english: He told me "Go straight and then turn right."
examples.transliteration: Huwwe qaali rooh doghri w ba'deen leff yameen

examples.arabic: جاوبني روح دغري بعدين لف يمين عند الاشارة بتلاقيه قدامك
examples.english: He answered me "Go straight then turn right at the traffic light, you'll find it in front of you."
examples.transliteration: Jaawabni rooh dughri ba'dein liff yameen 'and il-ishaara bitlaaqeeh quddamak.
